title: 2981. Find Longest Special Substring That Occurs Thrice I

examples.explanation: The longest special substring which occurs thrice is "aa": substrings "aaaa", "aaaa", and "aaaa". It can be shown that the maximum length achievable is 2.
There exists no special substring which occurs at least thrice. Hence return -1.
The longest special substring which occurs thrice is "a": substrings "abcaba", "abcaba", and "abcaba". It can be shown that the maximum length achievable is 1.
